entries.07a5b0e9f89fb3e8: A business that develops and provides standard components and other products used in factory automation machines (FA = factory automation). In addition to standard components such as shafts and linear guides, it also handles automatic positioning modules used in high-precision production equipment, optical technology-related experimental research equipment, and custom machine components. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥160,498 million, up 18.2% year on year, the largest growth of the three businesses. The company explains that capturing demand related to communications in China and its proprietary initiatives such as meviy, the Economy series and D-JIT were effective overseas. Fictiv Inc., acquired in June 2025, has been included in consolidation since July 2025 and is included in this business. The main operators are MISUMI Corporation, Suruga Seiki Production Platform Co., Ltd., Suruga Seiki Co., Ltd., Fictiv Inc., and others (37 companies in total).
